modelui.title: Model checks
modelui.intro: Instruction files AYAR generates for your model to carry out on your project, for what AYAR has no local tool for. AYAR calls no model and sends nothing to any service, and a model's result is a claim until a local check proves it.
modelui.outside: This page is not part of the full scan nor the purity score, and carries no «Passed» result.
modelui.needsNote: Templates that apply to this project alone, each with its reason
modelui.needsNone: No template applies to this project now.
modelui.noAssumption: No instruction file is generated on an assumption: write what is missing first, then «Generate instructions». What you write here goes into the file as text and is sent nowhere.
modelui.previewNote: Preview the whole file before saving or copying it
modelui.notApplicableNote: {names}; each with its reason when opened
modelui.claimsNote: Notes from your model's reports, with the state of each check
modelui.claimsNone: No model report yet. Each check shows here with its state once its instructions are generated and saved.
modelui.status.stale: Stale: the project changed since it was generated
modelui.progress: {proven, plural, =0 {No claim proven locally} one {# claim proven locally} other {# claims proven locally}}, {left, plural, =0 {none left} one {# left} other {# left}}:
modelui.awaiting: The instruction file was saved in the project and no result file has arrived yet.
modelui.notSaved: The instructions were generated and not saved in the project yet.
modelui.rejectedLine: Reason: {reason}. Its notes were not imported.
modelui.rejected.field: The refused field in the file:
modelui.rejected.explain: The file's notes were not imported and nothing changed in the results. Fix the file to the ai-result/1 schema or run the instructions again, then AYAR reads it anew.
modelui.provenNote: Ordinary findings a local check in AYAR proved
modelui.saved: The instruction file was saved at {path}
modelui.gitignore: Add .ayar/ai-results/ to .gitignore if you do not want to commit the model's results.
modelui.reject.tooLarge: the file is {bytes} bytes and the limit is {limit}
modelui.reject.claimsPass: it claims a pass, and only AYAR proves results
modelui.reject.schema: it does not match the ai-result/1 schema at {path} ({detail})
modelui.reject.unknownCheck: no instruction file with the id {id} in this project
modelui.reject.templateMismatch: the template {got} does not match the instructions template {expected}
